$comment: Gzip (level 9) byte budgets for the web app's client JavaScript, measured on the webpack build by scripts/ci/bundle-budget.mjs: about 10% above the measurement of main at 2026-10-31 08:57 UTC (shared 134215, largest route 378757 for /app/me, all chunks about 628 KB). The first measurement that morning was 334266 for the largest route; work merged during the day added about 13%. Raising a budget needs a reviewed reason; INTL-003 is expected to lower them. 2026-10-31 evening, ADM-002: the hub console adds its own route group (/admin, /admin/setup/[step] and one route for every console section) with about 6.7 KB of page chunks and no shared-chunk growth; main measured about 687,600 bytes for all chunks (671.5 KiB, LANG-ES, SANC-001 and others merged that day), the console brings it to 694,643, so the all-chunks budget moves from 691200 (675 KiB) to 701440 (685 KiB). Shared and largest-route budgets are unchanged. 2026-10-31 night, CTRY-003: the four example packs gain sourced v2 facts, and the country-packs module ships every pack to the client (the /app/me route among others), so all chunks grow from about 696,600 bytes (680.3 KiB on main at ce71ddb) to 704,502 (688.0 KiB) and the largest route from 397.4 to 405.1 KiB; the all-chunks budget moves from 701440 (685 KiB) to 711680 (695 KiB). Shared and largest-route budgets are unchanged. Follow-up: keep pack facets on the server (the browser needs only the v1 fields), which removes this growth and most of the US pack from the client.
